name: presence-indicator
title: PresenceIndicator
description: Live state for one or more users on a surface. Three forms — dot (small ring-bordered colored circle at the corner of an Avatar), inline (chip with text label + dot), avatar-group (live AvatarGroup with presence dots on each + 'editing N seconds ago'). Distinct from Avatar's presence prop — PresenceIndicator can stand alone in a Toolbar or above a Drawer.
